pages.title: About United Fintech - the only fintech platform you need
pages.main_text_excerpt:
About United Fintech
Who we are
United Fintech was founded in 2020 by Christian Frahm with a vision to build the neutral industry platform for wholesale finance.
Today more than 250 financial institutions run on United Fintech technology, including 10 of the 12 most systemically important banks in the world, built by around 200 people across 11 countries.
Leading global institutions have invested in United Fintech, and five of them sit on our board, across Europe, the United States, and Asia.
What we do
AI is changing what an institution can build and what it should buy. In non-core areas, and on the problems every institution shares, partnering now beats building alone.
Over the next ten years, every part of financial services has to be rebuilt from scratch. For the institutions doing the rebuilding, that means dozens of vendors, each with its own contract, security review, integration, and renewal. Implementations measured in years rather than weeks. And the same non-core work paid for separately by every institution in the industry.
Mission
United Fintech exists so that work happens once. We bring together great independent businesses, world-class domain experts, and the world's leading financial institutions on one platform, solving those problems across capital markets, commercial banking, and wealth and asset management.
One brand, one commercial agreement, one counterparty, dozens of solutions built by the top experts in the world leveraging AI to give speed and save costs for our customers.
Ownership
United Fintech is owned by its founder, early partners and investors. In 2024 it opened its ownership to its customers: BNP Paribas, Citi, Danske Bank, and Standard Chartered came in that year, Barclays followed, and in 2025 Danish Growth Capital became the company's first financial investor. 
No single bank controls the platform. That is the design, and it is what makes the infrastructure neutral.
Our principles
People are at the heart of everything we build, our team are our rockstars. We attract and empower experts across United Fintech, our products, and our partners, all sharing a passion for challenging convention and delivering meaningful impact.
Senior Leadership and Partner Group
Behind United Fintech is a leadership team that has run technology, finance, and operations at some of the world's largest financial institutions and fintech businesses. That experience is what it takes to build infrastructure the industry can trust: neutral, built once, and designed to serve financial institutions for the long term.
Christian Frahm
Christian started at Bloomberg, led sales and business development globally on the senior leadership team of Saxo Bank, and founded CFH Group in 2008. He sold the company in 2019 in a USD 120 million exit.
Christian founded United Fintech in 2020 with the vision of building the neutral platform in the middle of the industry: the future infrastructure every bank needs, built once, and held for the long term. Today more than 250 financial institutions run on United Fintech technology, including 10 of the 12 most systemically important banks in the world, and five of the world's leading wholesale banks co-invest alongside the founder, early partners and investors, with no single bank in control.
Alongside his role as CEO, Christian runs the United Fintech partner group.
"For the first time in 30 years, the technology underneath banking has to change. That is a rare opportunity to have a real impact on an industry, and it is why we exist: to build the infrastructure once, together with the institutions that run on it, and to give them the opportunity to own it with us."
Marc Levin
Former CEO of CFH Group, Marc has since successfully scaled enterprise fintech businesses including United Fintech, CobaltFX and Athena hands-on.
Partner & Group COO, he owns the operating model across United Fintech, ensuring every division executes and delivers with transparency, accountability and predictability.
Turning strategy into concrete goals, then following up on every one of them relentlessly, always. Transparency, accountability, and predictability in execution are what turn a good strategy into results you can measure.
“When the operating model is working efficiently, nobody feels any friction. Teams can simply move faster and deliver great results, quicker."
Rasmus Bagger
Formerly CEO of Netdania and commercial leader at Saxo Bank, Rasmus Bagger has spent his career at the intersection of fintech and financial markets.
Now as Group CCO & Partner, he drives commercial strategy and growth across the entire United Fintech ecosystem, heading multinational teams across sales, marketing, M&A, and RevOps.
"We're not selling point solutions. We're selling one contract and one relationship, built by highly-qualified teams working together across the entire business. This gives our global institutional clients a single point of entry into trusted institutional fintech."
Guy Hopkins
Founder of Fai

Wealth & Asset Management
Modern investment management, designed for real-time insights
Asset and wealth managers run increasingly sophisticated, multi-asset portfolios and need clear, intraday visibility across portfolios, risk and operations. pages.title: FairXchange - Horizon | Unitedfintech - Capital Markets
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Data driven insight for smarter, more sustainable trading and enhanced FX analytics
FairXchange Horizon is a data analytics platform that empowers clients to optimise liquidity pools, order flow, and pricing. It allows financial institutions to make data-driven decisions and build sustainable relationships through transparency, collaboration, and powerful visual analytics.
Horizon gives financial institutions clear visibility into their trading performance and FX liquidity management. Built by FX practitioners, it turns complex trading data into simple, actionable intelligence. With intuitive analytics and real-time reporting, users can monitor performance, detect anomalies, and benchmark counterparties using advanced FX data analysis techniques.
By connecting liquidity providers and clients through shared, objective data, we enable smarter execution, transparent communication, and commercially sustainable trading relationships across the institutional FX market.
Monitor your business
Gain real-time visibility into trade flow, pricing and counterparties, with FX analytics that support informed decisions and sustainable trading relationships.
Measure performance
Quantify trade performance across time and market conditions. Detailed markout and liquidity analytics show where value is created or lost to support best execution and strategy refinement.
Detect anomalies
Identify unusual patterns or off-market rates early. Intelligent alerts enhance transparency and enable proactive FX risk management.
A trading desk at a brokerage firm uses Horizon to analyse the flow they receive from clients and how that potentially impacts their liquidity providers. Using Horizon's state of the art FX liquidity analytics, they identify pockets of problematic flow and make appropriate changes to the liquidity made available to that counterparty.
Insight across every layer of your trading ecosystem
The Horizon platform includes four integrated modules: Core, Liquidity, AI and Algo, each offering specialised analytics that combine seamlessly for a complete trading intelligence and FX performance analytics framework. Together they provide transparency, protection and actionable insight across your entire e-trading workflow.
Key Capabilities
Built on standards. Backed by proof.
Our certifications confirm independently assessed controls and alignment with recognised industry frameworks.
FAQ
Browse through our most frequently asked questions for clarity and guidance.
How does the FairXchange Horizon platform impact liquidity management and profitability in trading operations?
FairXchange Horizon, part of United Fintech, enhances liquidity management by using advanced FX liquidity analytics to identify problematic flow and make adjustments to the liquidity provided to counterparties. The process improves the profitability of flow routed to liquidity providers. Enhanced execution quality results in increased business for brokers, as liquidity providers can better monetise flow, ultimately benefiting both parties involved. The Horizon platform's analytics allow trading desks to closely monitor and modify client flow, leading to better allocation of liquidity and improved trading conditions. By optimising liquidity, brokers can achieve superior execution outcomes, enhancing brokers service offering and competitive position. Learn more about FairXchange Horizon liquidity management.
What capabilities does FairXchange Horizon provide for monitoring trade flow and decision-making?
FairXchange Horizon provides comprehensive FX analytics and data-driven insights to monitor trade flow, pricing, and counterparties effectively. The platform enhances the ability of traders to maintain sustainable and profitable trading relationships while supporting real-time decision-making. Horizon allows users to gain continuous visibility, ensuring optimal trading conditions. The capabilities of Horizon are crucial for traders seeking to make informed decisions swiftly and accurately. By delivering detailed insights, Horizon helps users understand market dynamics and optimise trading strategies. The focus on real-time data ensures that current trading environments are reflected accurately, aiding in precise execution. Learn more about FairXchange Horizon.
How does the Sentinel feature in FairXchange Horizon AI provide risk management and compliance assurance?
The Sentinel feature in FairXchange Horizon AI delivers AI-powered monitoring and alerting for smarter supervision. Sentinel continuously monitors trading activity across all channels, utilising pattern recognition and behavioural analysis to detect anomalies and potential risks before they escalate, ensuring compliance and operational assurance. The Sentinel feature's intelligent alerting system prioritises commercially relevant changes, ensuring that teams are focused on actionable events, reducing noise in complex FX trading environments. pages.title: Want to have a career at at United Fintech | United Fintech
pages.main_text_excerpt:
Career
United Fintech brings together global talent and leading technology to shape finance.
Build the future
of finance
At United Fintech, we build technology that helps financial institutions see markets more clearly and make better decisions. Our teams combine deep market expertise with data, engineering, and product thinking to solve real problems in complex trading environments.
You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, work with experienced professionals, and help shape products used by leading institutions across global markets, doing work that has clear, tangible impact.
A culture built on growth and collaboration
We believe in ownership, transparency, and continuous learning. At United Fintech, you will work across teams and technologies. We celebrate diversity, encourage bold thinking, and empower people to grow; personally, professionally, and collectively. We see United Fintech as a team of individual rockstars, experts in their fields who collaborate, challenge each other, and achieve extraordinary results, together.
Shape the future of finance
From product and development to finance, operations, and commercial, our teams combine deep expertise with advanced technology to drive progress across the financial industry. By utilising AI and intelligent automation, we streamline workflows, reduce friction, and create a smarter, more connected working environment across United Fintech.
Building growth together, across the group
Growth at United Fintech is a collective effort, shaped by collaboration across product, technology, and central functions. Working across regions and disciplines our teams combine financial market expertise with strong engineering capability to design and scale robust solutions for a global client base.
Across our specialist product businesses, teams bring deep expertise in financial markets and technology. With product and engineering working side by side, we design, develop, and enhance platforms that solve real trading and workflow challenges. Our product teams span nearly every continent, with specialists close to local markets and clients, applying strong technical standards to build robust, scalable solutions.
Central teams including IT, Finance, Marketing, Revenue Operations, People, and Operations provide the foundations that enable consistent growth across the group. By connecting strategy with execution, these teams help United Fintech scale with clarity and precision.
What unites us is a culture that values expertise, collaboration, and learning. As we grow, we’re building an environment where global talent can deepen their specialism, share knowledge, and help shape the future of United Fintech.

With intuitive analytics and real-time reporting, users can monitor performance, detect anomalies, and benchmark counterparties using advanced FX data analysis techniques.
By connecting liquidity providers and clients through shared, objective data, we enable smarter execution, transparent communication, and commercially sustainable trading relationships across the institutional FX market.
Monitor your business
Gain real-time visibility into trade flow, pricing and counterparties, with FX analytics that support informed decisions and sustainable trading relationships.
Measure performance
Quantify trade performance across time and market conditions. Detailed markout and liquidity analytics show where value is created or lost to support best execution and strategy refinement.
Detect anomalies
Identify unusual patterns or off-market rates early. Intelligent alerts enhance transparency and enable proactive FX risk management.
A trading desk at a brokerage firm uses Horizon to analyse the flow they receive from clients and how that potentially impacts their liquidity providers. Using Horizon's state of the art FX liquidity analytics, they identify pockets of problematic flow and make appropriate changes to the liquidity made available to that counterparty.
Insight across every layer of your trading ecosystem
The Horizon platform includes four integrated modules: Core, Liquidity, AI and Algo, each offering specialised analytics that combine seamlessly for a complete trading intelligence and FX performance analytics framework. Together they provide transparency, protection and actionable insight across your entire e-trading workflow.

How does the FairXchange Horizon platform impact liquidity management and profitability in trading operations?
FairXchange Horizon, part of United Fintech, enhances liquidity management by using advanced FX liquidity analytics to identify problematic flow and make adjustments to the liquidity provided to counterparties. The process improves the profitability of flow routed to liquidity providers. Enhanced execution quality results in increased business for brokers, as liquidity providers can better monetise flow, ultimately benefiting both parties involved. The Horizon platform's analytics allow trading desks to closely monitor and modify client flow, leading to better allocation of liquidity and improved trading conditions. By optimising liquidity, brokers can achieve superior execution outcomes, enhancing brokers service offering and competitive position. Learn more about FairXchange Horizon liquidity management.
What capabilities does FairXchange Horizon provide for monitoring trade flow and decision-making?
FairXchange Horizon provides comprehensive FX analytics and data-driven insights to monitor trade flow, pricing, and counterparties effectively. Horizon allows users to gain continuous visibility, ensuring optimal trading conditions. The capabilities of Horizon are crucial for traders seeking to make informed decisions swiftly and accurately. By delivering detailed insights, Horizon helps users understand market dynamics and optimise trading strategies. The focus on real-time data ensures that current trading environments are reflected accurately, aiding in precise execution. Learn more about FairXchange Horizon.
How does the Sentinel feature in FairXchange Horizon AI provide risk management and compliance assurance?
The Sentinel feature in FairXchange Horizon AI delivers AI-powered monitoring and alerting for smarter supervision. Sentinel continuously monitors trading activity across all channels, utilising pattern recognition and behavioural analysis to detect anomalies and potential risks before they escalate, ensuring compliance and operational assurance. The Sentinel feature's intelligent alerting system prioritises commercially relevant changes, ensuring that teams are focused on actionable events, reducing noise in complex FX trading environments. Career
United Fintech brings together global talent and leading technology to shape finance.
Build the future
of finance
At United Fintech, we build technology that helps financial institutions see markets more clearly and make better decisions. Our teams combine deep market expertise with data, engineering, and product thinking to solve real problems in complex trading environments.
You’ll have the opportunity to take ownership, work with experienced professionals, and help shape products used by leading institutions across global markets, doing work that has clear, tangible impact.
A culture built on growth and collaboration
We believe in ownership, transparency, and continuous learning. At United Fintech, you will work across teams and technologies. We celebrate diversity, encourage bold thinking, and empower people to grow; personally, professionally, and collectively. We see United Fintech as a team of individual rockstars, experts in their fields who collaborate, challenge each other, and achieve extraordinary results, together.
Shape the future of finance
From product and development to finance, operations, and commercial, our teams combine deep expertise with advanced technology to drive progress across the financial industry. By utilising AI and intelligent automation, we streamline workflows, reduce friction, and create a smarter, more connected working environment across United Fintech.
Building growth together, across the group
Growth at United Fintech is a collective effort, shaped by collaboration across product, technology, and central functions. Working across regions and disciplines our teams combine financial market expertise with strong engineering capability to design and scale robust solutions for a global client base.
Across our specialist product businesses, teams bring deep expertise in financial markets and technology. With product and engineering working side by side, we design, develop, and enhance platforms that solve real trading and workflow challenges. Our product teams span nearly every continent, with specialists close to local markets and clients, applying strong technical standards to build robust, scalable solutions.
Central teams including IT, Finance, Marketing, Revenue Operations, People, and Operations provide the foundations that enable consistent growth across the group. By connecting strategy with execution, these teams help United Fintech scale with clarity and precision.
What unites us is a culture that values expertise, collaboration, and learning. As we grow, we’re building an environment where global talent can deepen their specialism, share knowledge, and help shape the future of United Fintech.
